r.title: IJA DOPIN OGUN SI TAN
r.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Ija dopin oguun si tan Olugbala jagun molu
(The strive is O'er, the battle done)
Orin ayo la o ma ko
(The victory of life is won The song of)
ALLELUIA!
(triumph has begun)
(ALLELUIA!)

[Verse 2]
Gbogbo ipa n'iku ti lo Sugbon Kristi f'ogun re
(The pow'rs of death have done their worst)
Aye! E ho iho ayo
(But Christ their legions hath dispersed)
ALLELUIA!
(Let shout of holy joy outburst)
(ALLELUIA!)

[Verse 3]
Ojo meta na ti koja O jinde kuro ninu oku
(The three sad days have quickly sped)
E f'ogo fun Oluwa wa
(He rises glorious from the dead)
ALLELUIA!
(All glory to our risen LORD)
(ALLELUIA!)

[Verse 4]
O d'ewon orun apadi O silekun orun sile
(He broke the age – bound chains of hell)
E korin yin segun re
(The bars from heav'ns high portals fell)
ALLELUIA!
(Let hymns of praise his triumph tell)
(ALLELUIA!)

[Verse 5]
Jesu, nipa iya t'oje Gba wa lowo oro iku
(LORD, by the stripes which wounded Thee)
K'a le ye, ka si ma yin o
(From death's strings thy servants free)
ALLELUIA!
(That we may live and sing to thee)
AMIN.
(ALLELUIA!)
(AMEN.)
